Jonas —

Thanks for sending this over. Aaron and I skimmed the draft this morning. Overall it looks good and the high-level results match our internal dashboards, but Aaron asked that we correct two specifics and tighten the quote language. I'm attaching a PDF with inline redlines (zenfleet_redlines_aaron.pdf).

Key redlines in summary:
- The "45% average token cost reduction" should be changed to "~40%" — depends on which date range; our fiscal Q2 calculation yields ~40%.
- For latency, replace "tail latency < 120ms at p95" with "p95 latency under 140 ms in production (US-West)" — we had a brief regression during one maintenance window earlier in the month.
- Aaron would prefer the quote attribute to be: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs while keeping production latency predictable — that made deploying new features possible without added infra overhead."

We can confirm logo use (ZenFleet primary lockup) and will attach the vector. Can you also confirm whether the case study will include anonymized telemetry or the exact dashboards? For compliance we prefer anonymized aggregated numbers in public collateral.

Thanks — will aim to get a final sign-off by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Rachel
